lines.text: Your day count's on the record. Keep an eye on it. Vantongeren does the speech; I do the walking.
Up you get. Vantongeren does the speech; I do the walking.

Clinic Row, out the door. Fitting's a fifth of the part's price, on top of the part if they sell it. Two in a hundred don't take: the part's gone and you shake a while. The counter shows the real sum.
Up you get. Ask me about the clinic before you sit down. Nobody needs a speech from me as well.
